title: kiln-eml state (<game>/kiln/state/eml.json), format 1
description: Written by kiln-eml (gpl/kiln-eml/kiln-eml/src/plugin.rs) once per start, read by the launcher (engine_mods::status) and the in-game mod list (Kiln.Ui ModCatalog). Readers ignore fields they do not know; new fields and state words are only ever added. docs/kiln/eml.md 'Logs and state'.

phase.description: aside: another loader runs the EML mods this start (EML's own dbghelp.dll, ShroudForge's, or ShroudForge hosted by Kiln); 'aside' says which.

id.description: The mod's manifest id; with phase aside the profile entry's id (the Library id).

source.description: profile, kiln-dropin, game-mods, or the name of the plugin that handed the mod in.

state.description: loaded | failed | skipped | disabled | duplicate | pending; with phase aside: own-loader (Kiln copied the profile mod into that loader's folder, it runs there) | not-loaded (the mod is only in Kiln's Library, the running loader never reads it). Readers treat unknown words as not loaded.
